o: When Nancy Hennessy is murdered, she leaves behind two best friends, an adoring husband and daughter, and a secret lover whose identity she took to the grave. Nancy was gorgeous, wealthy, and cherished by those who knew her―from the outside, her life was perfect. But as the investigation into her death flounders and her friends Eleanor and Mary wrestle with their grief, dark details surface that…

eps.o: Eleanor and Mary process their friend's gut-wrenching death.
Eleanor distracts herself from grief as an old temptation reemerges.
Secrets come to light, forcing Eleanor to confront her mistakes.
Nancy loses control at her annual New Year's party.
Nancy's lifelong passion for dance leads to an unexpected connection.
After a startling discovery, Mary struggles to square reality with perception.
Mary and Eleanor's quest for justice runs into complications.
As new information emerges, Mary and Eleanor risk it all to expose the truth and find closure.
